steps: Dry roast the oats in a small pan for a minute or two.
Peel and core the pear and chop it into small pieces.
Add the pear and about 100 ml water to the oats.
Cook on low heat for 5 to 7 minutes until the pear is soft.
Pour in the milk and simmer for one more minute.
Mash the pear pieces with the back of the spoon and stir in a pinch of cinnamon.
Let it cool until just warm before serving.
note: A pinch of cinnamon stands in for the cloves and dates one source uses, so there is no added sweetness. Pears ripen fast, so use a soft one.
